div.div: لَهُ إِنَاقَةٌ and أَنَاقَةٌ (K, and so in some copies of the S,) He has goodliness, or beauty, and pleasingness: but in the L, [and in some copies of the S,] لَهُ إِنَاقَةٌ وَلَبَاقةٌ; and what precedes it indicates that the meaning is he has a faculty of doing well or excellently [and of nice or refined skilfulness]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
